name: kapso
description: Turn coding-agent output into verified outcomes against a measurable objective with Kapso, from this session: set up, state the objective, launch and follow the campaign, review and deploy the result, author a harness for your domain.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify software toward an objective
interface.longDescription: Kapso runs experiment campaigns: it designs candidate solutions, has coding agents implement them, measures each one against your evaluation, and keeps the best. The plugin sets Kapso up, writes the objective and its evaluation with you, launches and follows the campaign, reviews and deploys the result, and authors a harness for your domain.
defaultPrompt: Set up Kapso on this machine and check it is ready
Build a better churn model here and prove it beats the current one
Write a Kapso harness for this repository's domain
